risk_factors.heading: Our results of operations could be affected by changes in tax-related matters.
risk_factors.quote: Changes in laws and regulations could affect the jurisdictions in which our profits are earned and taxed, which could in turn affect our results of operations.

risk_factors.heading: Our performance depends in part on our ability to enforce our intellectual property rights and to maintain freedom of operation.
risk_factors.quote: We actively enforce and protect our own intellectual property rights. However, our efforts cannot prevent all misappropriation or improper use of our protected technology and information

risk_factors.heading: Our performance depends in part on our ability to enforce our intellectual property rights and to maintain freedom of operation.
risk_factors.quote: We, directly and indirectly, face infringement claims from third parties, including nonpracticing entities that have acquired patents to pursue enforcement actions against other companies.

risk_factors.heading: Our debt could affect our operations and financial condition.
risk_factors.quote: our obligation to make principal and interest payments could divert funds that otherwise might be invested in our operations or returned to shareholders

risk_factors.heading: Our results of operations and liquidity could be affected by changes in the financial markets.
risk_factors.quote: If we are unable to access these accounts and credit lines (for example, due to instability in the financial markets), our results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected

risk_factors.heading: Material impairments of our goodwill could adversely affect our results of operations.
risk_factors.quote: We have a significant amount of goodwill on our consolidated balance sheet. Charges associated with impairments of goodwill could adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.
